presets.label: Low
presets.description: Lightest. Lighting and sun shadows use visible surfaces only; ray tracing and DLSS Ray Reconstruction are off.

presets.label: Medium
presets.description: Ray-traced lighting and sun shadows on solid surfaces, Fast local light shadows and Glossy reflections.

presets.label: High
presets.description: Adds foliage to ray tracing, Full local light shadows and Standard reflections.

presets.label: Ultra
presets.description: Adds hidden-roof, interior light and hair shadows, two-ray indirect lighting, Rough reflections, water lighting, Far off-screen bounce light and depth of field smoothing. Limits rendering to 58 fps.

knobs.label: DLSS Ray Reconstruction
knobs.description: Reduces noise in ray-traced lighting.
knobs.summary: Reduces noise in ray-traced lighting.
knobs.details: Needs an NVIDIA RTX GPU. Select DLSS as the upscaler in the game's graphics options.

knobs.label: Ray-tracing detail
knobs.description: Chooses what ray-traced lighting and shadows include: solid surfaces only, or also foliage, grates and chains.
knobs.apply_note: Restart the game after changing this setting
knobs.summary: Chooses what ray-traced lighting and shadows include: solid surfaces only, or also foliage, grates and chains.
knobs.details: Off turns off all ray-traced lighting, shadows, reflections and water.

knobs.label: Sun shadows
knobs.description: Ray-traced sun shadows. Include hidden roofs also keeps shadows from roofs and canopies the game hides near the camera.
knobs.summary: Ray-traced sun shadows. Include hidden roofs also keeps shadows from roofs and canopies the game hides near the camera.
knobs.details: Include hidden roofs costs about 0.3–1.3 ms more on an RTX 5090, depending on the scene.

knobs.label: Indirect lighting
knobs.description: Adds bounced light and soft shading where surfaces meet. The highest level traces two rays per pixel for less noise.
knobs.summary: Adds bounced light and soft shading where surfaces meet. The highest level traces two rays per pixel for less noise.

knobs.label: Local light shadows
knobs.description: Adds shadows from torches, lamps and spells.
knobs.summary: Adds shadows from torches, lamps and spells.
knobs.details: Fast needs DLSS Ray Reconstruction. Full keeps the game's own shadows where they are needed.

knobs.label: Reflections
knobs.description: Adds reflections to smooth surfaces and, at higher levels, rougher surfaces.
knobs.summary: Adds reflections to smooth surfaces and, at higher levels, rougher surfaces.
knobs.details: Needs Ray-tracing detail and Indirect lighting. Without DLSS Ray Reconstruction, only mirror-like reflections are traced.

knobs.label: Frame Generation
knobs.description: Adds generated frames between rendered frames for smoother motion.
knobs.apply_note: Restart when turning Frame Generation on or off; multiplier changes apply after saving
knobs.summary: Adds generated frames between rendered frames for smoother motion.
knobs.details: Needs NVIDIA Reflex On or On + Boost. Turning it on or off needs a game restart; switching between 2x, 3x and 4x applies after saving. Generated frames make motion smoother but do not raise the rendered frame rate.

knobs.label: Mod lighting strength
knobs.description: Blends indirect lighting, local shadows and reflections toward the game's original appearance at lower values.
knobs.summary: Blends indirect lighting, local shadows and reflections toward the game's original appearance at lower values.

knobs.label: Rendered frame limit
knobs.description: Limits the frame rate before Frame Generation adds frames.
knobs.summary: Limits the frame rate before Frame Generation adds frames.
knobs.details: Ultra limits rendering to 58 fps. A limit is a ceiling, not a target.

knobs.label: NVIDIA Reflex
knobs.description: Reduces the delay between your input and the image on screen.
knobs.summary: Reduces the delay between your input and the image on screen.
knobs.details: Frame Generation needs On or On + Boost.

knobs.label: Water lighting
knobs.description: Adds water reflections, shadows and, at the highest level, a refracted view of the riverbed or pool floor. About 0.5–0.7 ms on an RTX 5090 (estimate).
knobs.apply_note: Restart to enable; disabling applies after saving.
knobs.summary: Adds water reflections, shadows and, at the highest level, a refracted view of the riverbed or pool floor. About 0.5–0.7 ms on an RTX 5090 (estimate).
knobs.details: Needs Ray-tracing detail. Turning water on or raising its level needs a game restart; lowering it or turning it off applies after saving. Uses up to about 520 MB of video memory.

cost.provenance: Estimated water cost: 0.5–0.7 ms and up to 520 MB on RTX 5090 at Water Queens House.

knobs.label: DLSS 5 Neural Rendering (experimental)
knobs.description: (experimental) Neural relighting after Ray Reconstruction and before post effects and frame generation. Requires your own DLSS 5 runtime.
knobs.apply_note: Restart the game after changing DLSS 5 or its runtime file
knobs.summary: (experimental) Neural relighting after Ray Reconstruction and before post effects and frame generation. Requires your own DLSS 5 runtime.
knobs.details: Experimental and off in every preset. Requires Ray Reconstruction before post effects and a compatible user-provided nvngx_dlssnr.dll. The launcher prepares the runtime before Play; custom or unsigned runtimes are identified in the log and may be rejected by NVIDIA (0xbad0000b). Restart after changing this option or the runtime file.

knobs.label: Water surface reflections
knobs.description: Experimental: works out the reflection at the water surface separately from the water's depth colour. Mostly visible at the edges of shallow pools; open water barely changes.
knobs.summary: Experimental: works out the reflection at the water surface separately from the water's depth colour. Mostly visible at the edges of shallow pools; open water barely changes.
knobs.details: Needs Water lighting. Turning it on needs a game restart; turning it off applies after saving. Compare the reflections on shallow pools.

knobs.label: Frame generation pacing test
knobs.description: Experimental: may reduce frame generation stutter when the game replaces temporary images. Cost and smoothness are unqualified.
knobs.summary: Experimental: may reduce frame generation stutter when the game replaces temporary images. Cost and smoothness are unqualified.
knobs.details: Compare smoothness while turning in the same scene. Experimental; disabled in every preset.

knobs.label: Multi-frame presentation test
knobs.description: Experimental: enables an optional driver presentation capability for frame generation. Smoothness and cost are unqualified.
knobs.summary: Experimental: enables an optional driver presentation capability for frame generation. Smoothness and cost are unqualified.
knobs.details: Requires Frame generation and a game restart. Compare 3x smoothness in the same scene. Disabled in every preset.

knobs.label: Opacity micromaps
knobs.description: Accelerates cutout shadows with locally prepared foliage masks on compatible hardware. About 1 ms faster at camp on RTX 5090; requires a restart.
knobs.summary: Accelerates cutout shadows with locally prepared foliage masks on compatible hardware. About 1 ms faster at camp on RTX 5090; requires a restart.

cost.provenance: RTX 5090; camp om4; 2026-11-03 08:10; RT passes 8.65-8.75 ms vs reference 9.37-10.08 ms; 1.17G rays compared, 0 not compared, 0 violations. Reference only.

knobs.label: Offline cutout masks
knobs.description: Uses foliage masks prepared locally from your game installation. Required for accelerated cutout shadows; unavailable masks keep the original path.
knobs.summary: Uses foliage masks prepared locally from your game installation. Required for accelerated cutout shadows; unavailable masks keep the original path.

cost.provenance: RTX 5090; va1 camp 2026-11-02; energy +0.24% within +/-1.95% repeat band; RT passes unchanged. Masks generated on the player's PC. Reference only.

knobs.label: Off-screen bounce light
knobs.description: Adds bounced light and glow from surfaces outside the camera's view. Far carries sunlight bounce up to 6 m. About 0.6 ms for Near and 3–4 ms for Far on an RTX 5090.
knobs.apply_note: Restart to enable or disable; changing Near/Far may briefly pause.
knobs.summary: Adds bounced light and glow from surfaces outside the camera's view. Far carries sunlight bounce up to 6 m. About 0.6 ms for Near and 3–4 ms for Far on an RTX 5090.
knobs.details: Needs Ray-tracing detail: Include foliage and Indirect lighting: Ray-traced. Turning it on or off needs a game restart; switching between Near and Far may briefly pause the game.

cost.gpu: Near about 0.6 ms; Far about 4 ms
cost.provenance: Estimated cost on RTX 5090: about 0.6 ms for Near or 4 ms for Far.

knobs.label: Interior light shadows
knobs.description: Adds shadows from rectangular interior lights that are meant to cast them. About 0.13 ms on an RTX 5090 at Grymforge.
knobs.summary: Adds shadows from rectangular interior lights that are meant to cast them. About 0.13 ms on an RTX 5090 at Grymforge.
knobs.details: Needs Local light shadows. Lights the game marks as not casting shadows stay unshadowed.

knobs.label: RR order
knobs.description: Experimental: changes how fine hair edges appear through depth of field.
knobs.summary: Experimental: changes how fine hair edges appear through depth of field.
knobs.details: Moves RR before/after game post-processing. Dialogue3: thin hair against depth of field; compare dotted shimmer. Cost: unmeasured.

knobs.label: Depth of field and bloom smoothing
knobs.description: Blends background blur and bloom across frames to smooth fine edges. About 0.15 ms on an RTX 5090 in dialogue.
knobs.summary: Blends background blur and bloom across frames to smooth fine edges. About 0.15 ms on an RTX 5090 in dialogue.
knobs.details: Needs DLSS Ray Reconstruction. The effect is subtle; it is most visible in dialogue close-ups, on hair and fine edges against a blurred background.

cost.provenance: 250 MiB at 2560 × 1067 on RTX 5090 in dialogue.

knobs.label: Water camera correction
knobs.description: Keeps water reflections on while the camera turns (traces the reflection scene in its own camera space).
knobs.summary: Keeps water reflections on while the camera turns (traces the reflection scene in its own camera space).

cost.gpu: +0.00 ms (compose 0.12 ms on and off) S8
cost.provenance: RTX 5090; wf9 2026-11-03: turning screen hits 7% -> 17%, hidden 25% -> 15.5%, static delta 0 m, energy within noise

knobs.label: Hair shadows
knobs.description: Adds shadows and contact shading from the game's hair, including on faces and necks. About 2–6 ms in ray tracing and 3–9 ms in indirect lighting on an RTX 5090, depending on the scene.
knobs.apply_note: Restart to enable; disabling applies after saving.
knobs.summary: Adds shadows and contact shading from the game's hair, including on faces and necks. About 2–6 ms in ray tracing and 3–9 ms in indirect lighting on an RTX 5090, depending on the scene.
knobs.details: Needs Ray-tracing detail: Include foliage. Turning it on needs a game restart, and the first start may pause while shaders compile. Visible hair stays the game's own hair.

cost.provenance: Recorded RTX 5090 increases: 2.3–6.3 ms in the ray-tracing pass and 3.2–8.8 ms in indirect-light tracing, depending on scene.

knobs.label: Strand hair in ray-traced lighting
knobs.description: Experimental: uses individual strands for hair shadows and reflected light.
knobs.apply_note: live; supported LSS hardware and local groom files required
knobs.summary: Experimental: uses individual strands for hair shadows and reflected light.
knobs.details: Uses strands in RT shadows/AO/GI/reflections. Inspect hair shadows on faces and necks in Dialogue1.

cost.provenance: RTX 5090; Dialogue1 versus native cards. Reference only; qualification incomplete.

knobs.label: Strand hair on screen
knobs.description: Experimental: displays converted hairstyles as individual strands.
knobs.apply_note: restart required; experimental activation safety gate
knobs.summary: Experimental: displays converted hairstyles as individual strands.
knobs.details: Requires linear swept spheres, shaderInt64, fragment stores and local groom files. Moving hair currently keeps camera motion vectors. Cost and appearance remain unqualified; activation requires restart after a reported device-loss incident.

knobs.label: Physical strand shading
knobs.description: Experimental: gives on-screen hair brighter, warmer shading.
knobs.apply_note: live; needs Strand hair on screen
knobs.summary: Experimental: gives on-screen hair brighter, warmer shading.
knobs.details: Uses a fibre BSDF with multiple scattering instead of the game hair shading. Cost and appearance remain unqualified.

knobs.label: Strand indirect scattering
knobs.description: Uses the fibre volume's multiple-scattering reflectance for indirect light on visible strands. Experimental; cost and look unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: live; needs Strand hair on screen and GI
knobs.summary: Uses the fibre volume's multiple-scattering reflectance for indirect light on visible strands. Experimental; cost and look unqualified.

knobs.label: Strand specular reflections
knobs.description: Experimental: reflections and environment light on visible strands through the fibre's surface reflection instead of the game's hair term. Appearance and cost are unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: live; needs Strand hair on screen and RT reflections
knobs.summary: Experimental: reflections and environment light on visible strands through the fibre's surface reflection instead of the game's hair term. Appearance and cost are unqualified.

knobs.label: Strand shading for shadow-mapped lights
knobs.description: Experimental: physical strand shading also for local lights that have a game shadow map, with ray-traced shadows through the strands instead of the card shadow map. Appearance and cost are unqualified.
knobs.summary: Experimental: physical strand shading also for local lights that have a game shadow map, with ray-traced shadows through the strands instead of the card shadow map. Appearance and cost are unqualified.

knobs.label: Strand hair crowd budget
knobs.description: Experimental: gives nearby characters finer strands and reduces distant hair detail.
knobs.summary: Experimental: gives nearby characters finer strands and reduces distant hair detail.
knobs.details: Budgets total groom segments, not characters. Approximately 4 or 2 close characters respectively; actual counts depend on groom size. Refit and memory scale with the budget.

knobs.label: Strand shadow transmittance
knobs.description: Experimental: shadow rays through strand hair pass with the fibre's forward-scattered light per crossing instead of being blocked. Appearance and cost are unqualified.
knobs.summary: Experimental: shadow rays through strand hair pass with the fibre's forward-scattered light per crossing instead of being blocked. Appearance and cost are unqualified.

knobs.label: Strand AO transmittance
knobs.description: Experimental: ambient occlusion and indirect-light rays through strand hair pass with the fibre's forward-scattered light per crossing, as the strand shadows do, instead of stopping at the first strand. Appearance and cost are unqualified.
knobs.summary: Experimental: ambient occlusion and indirect-light rays through strand hair pass with the fibre's forward-scattered light per crossing, as the strand shadows do, instead of stopping at the first strand. Appearance and cost are unqualified.

knobs.label: Strand passes that swap
knobs.description: Diagnostic for on-screen strands: which passes may replace the cards (G-buffer, motion vectors, depth prepass). Unqualified.
knobs.summary: Diagnostic for on-screen strands: which passes may replace the cards (G-buffer, motion vectors, depth prepass). Unqualified.

knobs.label: Strand header in G-buffer order
knobs.description: Diagnostic for on-screen strands: writes the strand frame record in the G-buffer pass's own command buffer instead of the depth prepass's. Unqualified.
knobs.summary: Diagnostic for on-screen strands: writes the strand frame record in the G-buffer pass's own command buffer instead of the depth prepass's. Unqualified.

knobs.label: Dithered strand tips
knobs.description: Experimental: fades on-screen strand tips with the game mask alpha and temporal dither. Appearance and cost are unqualified.
knobs.summary: Experimental: fades on-screen strand tips with the game mask alpha and temporal dither. Appearance and cost are unqualified.

knobs.label: Strand sub-pixel coverage
knobs.description: Experimental: two camera rays per on-screen strand pixel instead of one, so distant sub-pixel strands alias less. Appearance and cost are unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: restart to enable; switches off live
knobs.summary: Experimental: two camera rays per on-screen strand pixel instead of one, so distant sub-pixel strands alias less. Appearance and cost are unqualified.
knobs.details: M3.2: compiled into the strand pipelines at their creation. Doubles the strand trace on strand candidate pixels. Compare thin strands against the sky or a bright wall in Test Dialogue1 while turning.

knobs.label: Strand hair: card normal
knobs.description: Experimental: on-screen strands give the game's hair lighting the hair card's own normal (the hair volume's surface) instead of a normal facing the camera. Appearance is unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: restart to enable; switches live after
knobs.summary: Experimental: on-screen strands give the game's hair lighting the hair card's own normal (the hair volume's surface) instead of a normal facing the camera. Appearance is unqualified.
knobs.details: 5g: compiled into the strand pipelines at their creation; no extra cost. Compare the hair's shading and strand definition in Test Dialogue1 (on/off/on).

knobs.label: Strand hair: world-space tangent
knobs.description: Experimental: on-screen strands write their tangent in world space, the space of the game's card tangent, so the hair highlights follow the strands. Appearance is unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: restart to enable; switches live after
knobs.summary: Experimental: on-screen strands write their tangent in world space, the space of the game's card tangent, so the hair highlights follow the strands. Appearance is unqualified.
knobs.details: 5g: compiled into the strand pipelines at their creation; no extra cost. Compare the hair highlights in Test Dialogue1 (on/off/on).

knobs.label: Strand hair: no card shadows
knobs.description: Experimental: hair whose strands are in the ray-traced scene stops casting its card silhouette into the game's sun shadow maps. Where the game's shadow is still used, that hair casts no shadow. Unqualified.
knobs.summary: Experimental: hair whose strands are in the ray-traced scene stops casting its card silhouette into the game's sun shadow maps. Where the game's shadow is still used, that hair casts no shadow. Unqualified.
knobs.details: M2.2: removes ribbon and double shadows under roofs. Compare the neck and shoulders under hair in Test Dialogue1, then the ground in Campsite.

knobs.label: RR hair guides
knobs.description: Experimental: Ray Reconstruction treats hair (cards and strands) as a dielectric fibre instead of reading its backlit value as metalness. Appearance is unqualified.
knobs.summary: Experimental: Ray Reconstruction treats hair (cards and strands) as a dielectric fibre instead of reading its backlit value as metalness. Appearance is unqualified.
knobs.details: M3.3: hair diffuse guide = base colour, specular guide from the fibre F0 0.0465, roughness >= 0.09. Compare hair highlights and hair noise in Test Dialogue1.

knobs.label: Retire unused hair snapshots
knobs.description: Reclaims unused hair capture memory.
knobs.summary: Reclaims unused hair capture memory.
knobs.details: Reclaims and packs unused native hair snapshots. Mesh pool reduction of 26-50% in the reference scenes; no numeric GPU timing available.

knobs.label: Physical hair ray origins (advanced)
knobs.description: Adjusts where light rays start on hair to improve secondary lighting. Quality and cost remain unqualified.
knobs.apply_note: Enable at startup to reserve ray-origin resources; then live A/B is available.
knobs.summary: Adjusts where light rays start on hair to improve secondary lighting. Quality and cost remain unqualified.

knobs.label: Detailed logging
knobs.description: Writes extra performance and diagnostic details to the log for bug reports. Leave it off for normal play.
knobs.summary: Writes extra performance and diagnostic details to the log for bug reports. Leave it off for normal play.

knobs.label: Experimental lighting reference
knobs.description: Shows a limited reference using point and spot lights on supported opaque surfaces. Two surfaces adds one indirect bounce; incomplete paths retain direct-only lighting and are counted. Requires Hidden-surface shading at startup. No sunlight, sky, emission or full-scene quality claim. This replaces the display for inspection; it is not a gameplay quality preset.
knobs.summary: Shows a limited reference using point and spot lights on supported opaque surfaces. Two surfaces adds one indirect bounce; incomplete paths retain direct-only lighting and are counted. Requires Hidden-surface shading at startup. No sunlight, sky, emission or full-scene quality claim. This replaces the display for inspection; it is not a gameplay quality preset.

knobs.label: Local light sampling (exact-k)
knobs.description: Cost option for interiors with many lights: the strongest 1 or 2 lights of each pixel keep their own shadow ray, and one ray is shared by the rest, picked in proportion to their light and weighted so the mean brightness is unchanged. Needs Local light shadows Full. Qualified k1 is automatic in Ultra; developer override only.
knobs.apply_note: First use may compile a core pipeline; no game restart.
knobs.summary: Cost option for interiors with many lights: the strongest 1 or 2 lights of each pixel keep their own shadow ray, and one ray is shared by the rest, picked in proportion to their light and weighted so the mean brightness is unchanged. Needs Local light shadows Full. Qualified k1 is automatic in Ultra; developer override only.

cost.provenance: RTX 5090; k1 scene energy -0.38/-0.34/+0.12%, within OFF spread 0.89%. Ultra approved 2026-11-04; lower presets unqualified.
